<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Restaurant"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-buzzer-process">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerInfo" name="Buzzer handed over with information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CallGuest" name="Guest called"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_StartOrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerInfo" name="Buzzer with information" sourceRef="Restaurant_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Restaurant_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" sourceRef="Restaurant_CallGuest" targetRef="Guest_CatchCallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at hatch" sourceRef="Guest_GoToHatch" targetRef="Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over" sourceRef="Restaurant_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Guest_CatchMealReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Guest process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_StartHungry" name="Guest feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_EnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_CatchBuzzerInfo" name="Buzzer and information received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_CatchBuzzerInfo_ED" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerInfo"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Guest_GW_Notice" name="Buzzer or call"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_CatchBuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_CatchBuzzerRings_ED" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_CatchCallGuest" name="Called by employee">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_CatchCallGuest_ED" messageRef="Msg_CallGuest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Guest_Merge_Hatch" name="Guest is notified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_CatchMealReceived" name="Meal handed over">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_CatchMealReceived_ED" messageRef="Msg_MealHandedOver"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Guest_EndDone" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_1" sourceRef="Guest_StartHungry" targetRef="Guest_EnterRestaurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_2" sourceRef="Guest_EnterRestaurant" targetRef="Guest_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_3" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_4" sourceRef="Guest_WaitTurn" targetRef="Guest_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_5" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_6" sourceRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerInfo" targetRef="Guest_GW_Notice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_7" sourceRef="Guest_GW_Notice" targetRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_8" sourceRef="Guest_GW_Notice" targetRef="Guest_CatchCallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_9" sourceRef="Guest_CatchBuzzerRings" targetRef="Guest_Merge_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_10" sourceRef="Guest_CatchCallGuest" targetRef="Guest_Merge_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_11" sourceRef="Guest_Merge_Hatch" targetRef="Guest_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_12" sourceRef="Guest_GoToHatch" targetRef="Guest_CatchMealReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_13" sourceRef="Guest_CatchMealReceived" targetRef="Guest_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF_14" sourceRef="Guest_EatMeal" targetRef="Guest_EndDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Restaurant process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restaurant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_StartOrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_EnterOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CollectPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_SetupBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_HandOverBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_Merge_Wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_GW_WaitGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CatchTimer5Min</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_EndMealServed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_PlaceInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_InformEmployeeReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Restaurant_StartOrderPlaced" name="Guest places order">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Restaurant_StartOrderPlaced_ED" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_CollectPayment" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_HandOverBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer with information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_InformEmployeeReady" name="Inform employee meal is in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Restaurant_Merge_Wait" name="Waiting for guest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Restaurant_GW_WaitGuest" name="Guest at hatch or timeout"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch_ED" messageRef="Msg_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Restaurant_CatchTimer5Min" name="After 5 minutes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Restaurant_CatchTimer5Min_ED">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_CallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Restaurant_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Restaurant_EndMealServed" name="Meal served"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_1" sourceRef="Restaurant_StartOrderPlaced" targetRef="Restaurant_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_2" sourceRef="Restaurant_EnterOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_3" sourceRef="Restaurant_CollectPayment" targetRef="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_4" sourceRef="Restaurant_SetupBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_HandOverBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_5" sourceRef="Restaurant_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_6" sourceRef="Restaurant_InformChef" targetRef="Restaurant_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_7" sourceRef="Restaurant_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_8" sourceRef="Restaurant_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Restaurant_InformEmployeeReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_9" sourceRef="Restaurant_InformEmployeeReady" targetRef="Restaurant_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_10" sourceRef="Restaurant_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Restaurant_Merge_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_11" sourceRef="Restaurant_CallGuest" targetRef="Restaurant_Merge_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_12" sourceRef="Restaurant_Merge_Wait" targetRef="Restaurant_GW_WaitGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_13" sourceRef="Restaurant_GW_WaitGuest" targetRef="Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_14" sourceRef="Restaurant_GW_WaitGuest" targetRef="Restaurant_CatchTimer5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_15" sourceRef="Restaurant_CatchTimer5Min" targetRef="Restaurant_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_16" sourceRef="Restaurant_CatchGuestAtHatch" targetRef="Restaurant_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF_17" sourceRef="Restaurant_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_EndMealServed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
